headline: STORM rolls onto the demo shelf
lede: A thunderstorm rolling over an open field — volumetric cumulonimbus, driving rain, forked lightning with delayed thunder — now lives at jalfern.com/retrogames/demos/storm.html, shipped solo from issue to production in one session.

notes.text: STORM (#672): raymarched lobed cumulonimbus with a flat wall base, low lateral sun, storm-dark field, two-slab rain streaks, double-stroke flashes and cloud-to-ground bolts — thunder answers after the real distance/340 delay. Rolls in from 7 km over six minutes.
stormcheck: 21 pixel gates, proven-fail by zeroing the in-cloud extinction; creditscheck extended to 62 gates with the storm card. Both green.

Lesson learned the hard way: restoring a mutation test with git checkout -- file silently destroyed that file's uncommitted work mid-session. Checkpoint before you mutate, restore from a saved copy, never from git.
QA polish pass filed as #747: crowning towers, sharper billow cusps, gusting rain, shelf arc, spread-out bolt landings.
